item.description:
Cape Canaveral, Florida, US — The SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket carrying Nasa’s CRS-35 mission creates the distinctive space jellyfish effect as it lifts off. The timing of the blastoff, 48 minutes before sunrise at Florida’s Cape Canaveral space force station, provided a perfect example of the colourful effect, which is fully visible from Earth only during dusk and dawn launches. — Photograph: Cristóbal Herrera/EPA

The remnants of Tropical Storm Rachel hit Baja California in Mexico over the weekend, as well as southern California and Las Vegas. While meteorologists said Rachel had weakened into a post-tropical cyclone as it approached California, it still left a trail of destruction. — Photograph: Daniel Cole/Reuters

Gaza — A Palestinian girl stands amid the rubble of destroyed buildings after an Israeli airstrike. Israel is refusing to allow a key military outpost project for Donald Trump’s Board of Peace to proceed in Gaza. In early August, the board, an international organisation authorised in 2025 by the UN and chaired by the US president, issued its first construction contract for Gaza: Louisiana-based Arkel International would construct a military outpost for 150 international troops that would be the vanguard of an international stabilisation force. — Photograph: Adam Bilal/Anadolu/Getty Images
